description: Deliberately publish public Library context for operator approval, read an exact live Library/Board/owned Trail revision, or explicitly acknowledge a previously read revision. Read is not acknowledgment; acknowledgment means neither agreement nor approval. No automatic memory collection. Receipts expire within seven days and never extend the publication lease. audit: unavailable means the operation succeeded but its event log write failed; do not repeat a publication just to repair audit.

audience.description: Required explicit audience for Library publication.

body.description: Deliberately published public context, secret-scanned and at most 10000 characters.

op.description: Choose deliberate publication, exact retrieval, or explicit acknowledgment.

origin.description: Required source origin for Library provenance, without credentials.

recordId.description: Publication row id. A World id conveys no audience authority.

revision.description: Exact revision from read; required for acknowledgment.

surface.description: Existing source surface; Trail is restricted to the authenticated author.

title.description: Required publication title, at most 200 characters.

name: context
